title: Warm pools and claims
design_ref: Sandbox lifecycle: templates, warm pools and claims
purpose: Show that a session claims a pre-booted sandbox in well under a second, that the pool refills, and that an empty pool degrades to a slower cold start instead of failing.

steps.output:
NAME                                                               READY   DESIRED   AGE
sandboxwarmpool.extensions.agents.x-k8s.io/compute-only-pool       1       1         14m
sandboxwarmpool.extensions.agents.x-k8s.io/python-untrusted-pool   2       2         14m

NAME                                                          AGE
sandboxtemplate.extensions.agents.x-k8s.io/compute-only       14m
sandboxtemplate.extensions.agents.x-k8s.io/python-untrusted   14m

steps.display: kubectl -n sandboxes get pods -o wide   # the warm pods, already booted and waiting
steps.output:

python-untrusted-pool-2mxkk   1/1     Running   0          2m22s   10.20.87.112   i-0021b8afd01dfb486   <none>           <none>

sess-27d2cc6a  ready in 346 ms

compute-only-pool       1       1         14m

steps.display: kubectl get nodeclaims -o custom-columns=<name, pool, instance type, created>   # did the slow start launch a node?
steps.output:

general-purpose-wwhpt   general-purpose   c6a.large    2026-11-19T15:11:57Z

checks.description: two sessions got a ready sandbox in under 2 seconds
checks.because: They adopted pods that were already booted; nothing started on the claim path.

checks.description: the third session, which found the pool empty, still got a sandbox (a slower cold start)
checks.because: Cold start took 10097 ms against 343 ms warm. An empty pool degrades; it does not fail.

checks.description: the warm pool refilled to its desired size
checks.because: The controller boots a replacement for every pod a claim adopts.

notes: Sandbox node claims after the burst: 2. Compare their creation times with the session start times above.
